scope: Concern archive confirmation, undo and same-owner History restore; header worker integration retained

tests.method: Deterministic hook/component tests, real AppDialog prop routing with runtime stubs, and installed RN Web ModalContent Escape handler; no browser interaction

semantic.method: TypeScript program rooted at the affected Growth files and AppDialog, including imported dependencies; no full application build

behavior: End-concern trigger and confirmation use filled danger controls with explicit borderWidth 0
Open, cancel and Escape do not dispatch a write; confirmation is consumed once and frozen to scope/child/id/version/authority
Changed version, authority, scope or disabled state invalidates an open confirmation before it can write
Undo and History restore call the same required restoreConcern display port and same preview owner
Restore returns the pre-archive proposed/following state without upgrading review state, adds a restore event, preserves archive history and original attention/topic/task data
Unknown restore is recoverable in History via the shared original-request component; no route change required
Stale version/authority, source loss, role/busy/dirty/pending guards and unmounted callbacks remain blocked
Undo is offered only for the matching successful archive change and current authorized version; History restore remains available later without an artificial expiry timer

failures_and_resolution.cause: Paper Dialog props exposed by AppDialog had no accessible name prop
failures_and_resolution.resolution: Parent approved an optional accessibilityLabel routed to RN Modal, excluded from PaperDialog props; final semantic passed

failures_and_resolution.cause: Test double omitted motionTokens.dialog used to render the existing transform
failures_and_resolution.resolution: Completed the test double only; 20 tests then passed

contract_changes.GrowthConcern: optional statusBeforeArchive: proposed | following; required for a safe preview restoration
contract_changes.GrowthConcernDecision: action: archive | restore with original expectedVersion/authorityVersion/confirm
contract_changes.GrowthViewModel: optional lastConcernChange with scope/authority/id/version/action for a version-bound Undo affordance
contract_changes.formal_backend: No endpoint or API adapter was invented; formal archive/restore and authoritative read projection remain unconnected. Missing pre-archive status disables restoration instead of guessing or reporting success.
